name: Croatia
summary: Possessing drugs for personal use is a misdemeanour (fine of about €660–2,650; treatment can be ordered instead), not a crime. Selling, intent to sell and growing are crimes. Medical cannabis is legal.

poisonControl.name: Centar za kontrolu otrovanja, Institute for Medical Research (IMI), Zagreb

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law. Personal-use possession is only a misdemeanour and medical staff are bound by confidentiality, but police may attend overdoses.
drugChecking: No established public drug checking service is known in Croatia.

zszd.title: IDPC (Dec 2012): Croatia decriminalises possession for personal use from 2013 (fine up to ~€2,680, rehab or community service possible)

wikiCannabis.title: Wikipedia: Cannabis in Croatia (misdemeanour fine 5,000–20,000 kn; medical since 2015)

wikiMush.title: Wikipedia: Legal status of psilocybin mushrooms (Croatia: decriminalised)

un1971.title: INCB Green List: psychotropic substances under international control (1971 Convention)

euN2O.title: EU Perspectives (Mar 2026): nitrous oxide classified reprotoxic; large canisters may be barred from consumer sale from Feb 2027

lsd.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine (≈€660–2,650). Amounts or circumstances suggesting sale make it a crime.

mushrooms.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine. Growing is formally illegal but rarely enforced.

dmt.note: UN Schedule I. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime. Ayahuasca contains DMT.

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime.

dox.note: DOB, DOM, DOC are UN-scheduled. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

nbomes.note: 25I/25B/25C-NBOMe are UN Schedule I. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are UN-scheduled. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are UN Schedule I. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not UN-scheduled; whether 5-MeO-DMT and related tryptamines are on Croatia's national list was not verified.

cannabis.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine (≈€660–2,650). Growing or selling is a crime. Cannabis medicines on prescription since 2015.

ketamine.note: Prescription/veterinary anaesthetic. Without a prescription, possession is treated like other drugs (misdemeanour fine).

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is UN Schedule II. Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine.

dxm.note: Not internationally controlled; pharmacy (OTC vs prescription) status in Croatia was not verified.

nitrous.note: Not a known controlled drug; national sales rules were not verified. EU limits on large canisters may apply from 2027.

amphetamines.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime. ADHD medicines are prescription-only.

mdma.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine (≈€660–2,650); supply or intent to sell is a crime.

cocaine.note: Possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply or intent to sell is a crime.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale and serving to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is controlled; possession for own use is a misdemeanour fine. Status of GBL/1,4-BD not verified. Oxybate is prescription-only.

opioids.note: Heroin possession for own use: misdemeanour fine; supply is a crime. Prescription opioids need a prescription; opioid substitution is available.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine; whether possession without a prescription is penalised was not verified.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only, UN Schedule IV; possession without a prescription is likely treated as an illicit-drug misdemeanour.

maois.note: Pharmaceutical MAOIs are prescription-only. The status of harmala/Syrian rue was not verified; DMT in ayahuasca is controlled.
